name: Causalean.Stat.CLT.BerryEsseen.prawitz_le_roundUp
statement: theorem prawitz_le_roundUp (x : ℚ) : x ≤ prawitzRoundUp x

name: Causalean.Stat.CLT.BerryEsseen.prawitz_rational_pi_bounds
statement:
theorem prawitz_rational_pi_bounds :
    (314159 / 100000 : ℝ) ≤ Real.pi ∧ Real.pi ≤ 314160 / 100000

name: Causalean.Stat.CLT.BerryEsseen.prawitz_taylor16_pos_le_exp
statement:
theorem prawitz_taylor16_pos_le_exp (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 ≤ x) :
    0 < (∑ m ∈ range 16, x ^ m / (m.factorial : ℝ)) ∧
      (∑ m ∈ range 16, x ^ m / (m.factorial : ℝ)) ≤ Real.exp x

name: Causalean.Stat.CLT.BerryEsseen.prawitz_compact_parameter_cell_exists
statement:
theorem prawitz_compact_parameter_cell_exists
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ0 : 1 / 100 ≤ ρ) (hρ1 : ρ ≤ 1) :
    ∃ j : Fin 270, (prawitzCompactLeft j.val : ℝ) ≤ ρ ∧
      ρ ≤ (prawitzCompactRight j.val : ℝ)

name: Causalean.Stat.CLT.BerryEsseen.prawitz_compact_real_cutoff_enclosures
statement:
theorem prawitz_compact_real_cutoff_enclosures
    (j : Fin 270) (ρ : ℝ)
    (hrρ : (prawitzCompactLeft j.val : ℝ) ≤ ρ)
    (hρs : ρ ≤ (prawitzCompactRight j.val : ℝ)) :
    let B := (prawitzLowCutoffIndex j.val : ℝ) / 200
    let A := (prawitzHighCutoffIndex j.val : ℝ) / 1000
    let U0 := max (3 / 2 : ℝ) (Real.sqrt (4 * Real.log (1 / ρ)))
    let U := 12 / (5 * ρ)
    U0 ≤ B ∧ B ≤ U ∧ U * A ≤ U0

name: Causalean.Stat.CLT.BerryEsseen.prawitz_kernel_rational_square_certificate
statement:
theorem prawitz_kernel_rational_square_certificate
    (i : ℕ) (hi : i ∈ Ico 1 1000) :
    prawitzRationalKernelSq i ≤
      ((prawitzKernelMagnitudeIndex i : ℚ) / 1000000) ^ 2

name: Causalean.Stat.CLT.BerryEsseen.prawitz_high_rescaled_lower_cell_integral_bound
statement:
theorem prawitz_high_rescaled_lower_cell_integral_bound
    (ρ r s a b : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (hrρ : r ≤ ρ) (hρs : ρ ≤ s)
    (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a ≤ b) (hb : b ≤ 1 / 2) :
    let U := 12 / (5 * ρ)
    let Q := (1 - a) ^ 2 / 4 +
      (((1 - a) * (1 - (Real.pi * a) ^ 2 / 2 + (Real.pi * b) ^ 4 / 24) /
        (Real.pi * a * (1 - (Real.pi * b) ^ 2 / 6)) + 1 / Real.pi) / 2) ^ 2
    let E := max ((-72 * a ^ 2 / 25 + 1728 * a ^ 3 / 625) / s ^ 2)
      ((-72 * b ^ 2 / 25 + 1728 * b ^ 3 / 625) / s ^ 2)
    (∫ t in (U * a)..(U * b),
      ‖prawitzKernel (t / U)‖ * prawitzMomentEnvelope ρ t) ≤
      (12 / (5 * r)) * (b - a) * Real.sqrt Q * min 1 (Real.exp E)

name: Causalean.Stat.CLT.BerryEsseen.prawitz_high_rescaled_upper_cell_integral_bound
statement:
theorem prawitz_high_rescaled_upper_cell_integral_bound
    (ρ r s a b : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (hrρ : r ≤ ρ) (hρs : ρ ≤ s)
    (ha : 1 / 2 ≤ a) (hab : a ≤ b) (hb : b ≤ 1) :
    let U := 12 / (5 * ρ)
    let Q := (1 - a) ^ 2 / 4 + Real.pi ^ 2 * (1 - a) ^ 4 / 16
    let E := max ((-72 * a ^ 2 / 25 + 1728 * a ^ 3 / 625) / s ^ 2)
      ((-72 * b ^ 2 / 25 + 1728 * b ^ 3 / 625) / s ^ 2)
    (∫ t in (U * a)..(U * b),
      ‖prawitzKernel (t / U)‖ * prawitzMomentEnvelope ρ t) ≤
      (12 / (5 * r)) * (b - a) * Real.sqrt Q * min 1 (Real.exp E)

name: Causalean.Stat.CLT.BerryEsseen.prawitz_rescaled_moment_cell_bound
statement:
theorem prawitz_rescaled_moment_cell_bound
    (ρ s u a b : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hρs : ρ ≤ s)
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hau : a ≤ u) (hub : u ≤ b) (hb : b ≤ 1) :
    prawitzMomentEnvelope ρ ((12 / (5 * ρ)) * u) ≤
      min 1 (Real.exp (max
        ((-72 * a ^ 2 / 25 + 1728 * a ^ 3 / 625) / s ^ 2)
        ((-72 * b ^ 2 / 25 + 1728 * b ^ 3 / 625) / s ^ 2)))

name: Causalean.Stat.CLT.BerryEsseen.prawitz_high_real_exponential_enclosure
statement:
theorem prawitz_high_real_exponential_enclosure
    (j : Fin 270) (i : ℕ) (hi : i ∈ Ico 1 1000) :
    let s := (prawitzCompactRight j.val : ℝ)
    let a := (i : ℝ) / 1000
    let b := ((i + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / 1000
    let E := max ((-72 * a ^ 2 / 25 + 1728 * a ^ 3 / 625) / s ^ 2)
      ((-72 * b ^ 2 / 25 + 1728 * b ^ 3 / 625) / s ^ 2)
    let aq := (i : ℚ) / 1000
    let bq := ((i + 1 : ℕ) : ℚ) / 1000
    let e := min (72 * aq ^ 2 / 25 - 1728 * aq ^ 3 / 625)
      (72 * bq ^ 2 / 25 - 1728 * bq ^ 3 / 625) /
        (prawitzCompactRight j.val) ^ 2
    Real.exp E ≤ ((1 / prawitzTaylor16 e : ℚ) : ℝ)

name: Causalean.Stat.CLT.BerryEsseen.prawitz_high_real_kernel_square_enclosure
statement:
theorem prawitz_high_real_kernel_square_enclosure
    (i : ℕ) (hi : i ∈ Ico 1 1000) :
    let a := (i : ℝ) / 1000
    let b := ((i + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / 1000
    let Q := if i < 500 then
      (1 - a) ^ 2 / 4 +
        (((1 - a) * (1 - (Real.pi * a) ^ 2 / 2 + (Real.pi * b) ^ 4 / 24) /
          (Real.pi * a * (1 - (Real.pi * b) ^ 2 / 6)) + 1 / Real.pi) / 2) ^ 2
      else (1 - a) ^ 2 / 4 + Real.pi ^ 2 * (1 - a) ^ 4 / 16
    Q ≤ (prawitzRationalKernelSq i : ℝ)

name: Causalean.Stat.CLT.BerryEsseen.prawitz_budget_high_compact
Causalean.Stat.CLT.BerryEsseen.gaussian_reciprocal_linear_tail_bound
statement:
theorem gaussian_reciprocal_linear_tail_bound
    (a b c : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hc : 0 ≤ c) :
    (∫ t in Set.Ioi a,
      (1 / (Real.pi * t) + c) * Real.exp (-(b * t ^ 2))) ≤
      (1 / (2 * Real.pi * b * a ^ 2) + c / (2 * b * a)) *
        Real.exp (-(b * a ^ 2))

name: Causalean.Stat.CLT.BerryEsseen.prawitz_far_gaussian_tail_budget
statement:
theorem prawitz_far_gaussian_tail_budget

Causalean.Stat.CLT.BerryEsseen.prawitz_high_compact_lower_cell_integral_bound
statement:
theorem prawitz_high_compact_lower_cell_integral_bound
    (ρ r s a b : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (hrρ : r ≤ ρ) (hρs : ρ ≤ s)
    (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a ≤ b) (hbU : b ≤ 12 / (5 * ρ))
    (hhalf : 5 * s * b / 12 ≤ 1 / 2) :
    let α := 5 * r * a / 12
    let β := 5 * s * b / 12
    let Q := (1 - α) ^ 2 / 4 +
      (((1 - α) * (1 - (Real.pi * α) ^ 2 / 2 + (Real.pi * β) ^ 4 / 24) /
        (Real.pi * α * (1 - (Real.pi * β) ^ 2 / 6)) + 1 / Real.pi) / 2) ^ 2
    let E := max (-(a ^ 2 / 2) + s * a ^ 3 / 5)
      (-(b ^ 2 / 2) + s * b ^ 3 / 5)
    (∫ t in a..b,
      ‖prawitzKernel (t / (12 / (5 * ρ)))‖ * prawitzMomentEnvelope ρ t) ≤
      (b - a) * Real.sqrt Q * min 1 (Real.exp E)

name: Causalean.Stat.CLT.BerryEsseen.prawitz_high_compact_upper_cell_integral_bound
statement:
theorem prawitz_high_compact_upper_cell_integral_bound
    (ρ r s a b : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (hrρ : r ≤ ρ) (hρs : ρ ≤ s)
    (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a ≤ b) (hbU : b ≤ 12 / (5 * ρ))
    (hhalf : 1 / 2 ≤ 5 * r * a / 12) :
    let α := 5 * r * a / 12
    let Q := (1 - α) ^ 2 / 4 + Real.pi ^ 2 * (1 - α) ^ 4 / 16
    let E := max (-(a ^ 2 / 2) + s * a ^ 3 / 5)
      (-(b ^ 2 / 2) + s * b ^ 3 / 5)
    (∫ t in a..b,
      ‖prawitzKernel (t / (12 / (5 * ρ)))‖ * prawitzMomentEnvelope ρ t) ≤
      (b - a) * Real.sqrt Q * min 1 (Real.exp E)

name: Causalean.Stat.CLT.BerryEsseen.prawitz_low_compact_endpoint_cell_integral_bound
statement:
theorem prawitz_low_compact_endpoint_cell_integral_bound
    (ρ r s a b : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (hrρ : r ≤ ρ) (hρs : ρ ≤ s)
    (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a ≤ b) (hbU : b ≤ 12 / (5 * ρ)) :
    let E := max (-(a ^ 2 / 2) + s * a ^ 3 / 5)
      (-(b ^ 2 / 2) + s * b ^ 3 / 5)
    (5 / 6 : ℝ) * (∫ t in a..b,
      ‖prawitzKernel (t / (12 / (5 * ρ)))‖ * prawitzDiscrepancyEnvelope ρ t) ≤
      (b - a) * (1 / (Real.pi * a) + 5 * s / 12) *
        min ((b ^ 3 / 6 + s * b ^ 4 / 8) * Real.exp (E / 2))
          ((min 1 (Real.exp E) + Real.exp (-(a ^ 2 / 2))) / r)

name: Causalean.Stat.CLT.BerryEsseen.prawitz_low_real_cell_enclosure
statement:
theorem prawitz_low_real_cell_enclosure
    (j : Fin 270) (i : ℕ)
    (hi : i ∈ Ico 1 (prawitzLowCutoffIndex j.val)) :
    let r := (prawitzCompactLeft j.val : ℝ)
    let s := (prawitzCompactRight j.val : ℝ)
    let a := (i : ℝ) / 200
    let b := ((i + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / 200
    let E := max (-(a ^ 2 / 2) + s * a ^ 3 / 5)
      (-(b ^ 2 / 2) + s * b ^ 3 / 5)
    (b - a) * (1 / (Real.pi * a) + 5 * s / 12) *
      min ((b ^ 3 / 6 + s * b ^ 4 / 8) * Real.exp (E / 2))
        ((min 1 (Real.exp E) + Real.exp (-(a ^ 2 / 2))) / r) ≤
          (prawitzRationalLowCell j.val i : ℝ)

statement:
theorem iid_unit_variance_charFun_refined_local_product_bound
    (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (M3 : ℝ) (hM3 : 1 ≤ M3)
    (hmean_int : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => x) μ)
    (hmean : ∫ x : ℝ, x ∂μ = 0)
    (hvar_int : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 2) μ)
    (hvar : ∫ x : ℝ, x ^ 2 ∂μ = 1)
    (hthird_int : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => |x| ^ 3) μ)
    (hthird : ∫ x : ℝ, |x| ^ 3 ∂μ ≤ M3)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 4 ≤ n) (t : ℝ)
    (ht : |t| ≤ Real.sqrt (n : ℝ) / (2 * M3)) :
    ‖(charFun μ (t / Real.sqrt (n : ℝ))) ^ n -
      charFun (gaussianReal 0 1) t‖ ≤
      (M3 / (4 * Real.sqrt (n : ℝ))) * |t| ^ 3 *
        Real.exp (-(t ^ 2 / 4))

name: Causalean.Stat.CLT.BerryEsseen.iid_unit_variance_charFun_refined_interval_integral_bound
statement:
theorem iid_unit_variance_charFun_refined_interval_integral_bound
    (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (M3 : ℝ) (hM3 : 1 ≤ M3)
    (hmean_int : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => x) μ)
    (hmean : ∫ x : ℝ, x ∂μ = 0)
    (hvar_int : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 2) μ)
    (hvar : ∫ x : ℝ, x ^ 2 ∂μ = 1)
    (hthird_int : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => |x| ^ 3) μ)
    (hthird : ∫ x : ℝ, |x| ^ 3 ∂μ ≤ M3)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 4 ≤ n) :
    (∫ t in (-(Real.sqrt (n : ℝ) / (2 * M3)))..
        (Real.sqrt (n : ℝ) / (2 * M3)),
      ‖(charFun μ (t / Real.sqrt (n : ℝ))) ^ n -
        charFun (gaussianReal 0 1) t‖ / |t|) ≤
      2 * M3 / Real.sqrt (n : ℝ)

statement:
theorem csc_squared_reciprocal_series (x : ℝ)
    (hsin : Real.sin (Real.pi * x) ≠ 0) :
    Summable (fun n : ℕ =>
      1 / (x - ((n : ℝ) + 1)) ^ 2 + 1 / (x + ((n : ℝ) + 1)) ^ 2) ∧
    (Real.sin (Real.pi * x) / Real.pi) ^ 2 *
      (1 / x ^ 2 + (∑' n : ℕ,
        (1 / (x - ((n : ℝ) + 1)) ^ 2 +
         1 / (x + ((n : ℝ) + 1)) ^ 2))) = 1

name: Causalean.Stat.CLT.BerryEsseen.prawitz_abel_weighted_integral_tendsto
statement:
theorem prawitz_abel_weighted_integral_tendsto (x : ℝ) :
    Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1,
      (1 - t) *
        (2 * r * Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * t) /
          (1 - 2 * r * Real.cos (2 * Real.pi * t) + r ^ 2)) *
        Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * x * t))
      (nhdsWithin 1 (Set.Iio 1))
      (𝓝 (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1,
        (1 - t) * Real.cos (Real.pi * t) / Real.sin (Real.pi * t) *
          Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * x * t)))

name: Causalean.Stat.CLT.BerryEsseen.prawitz_abel_weighted_integral_series
statement:
theorem prawitz_abel_weighted_integral_series
    (x r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (hr1 : r < 1) :
    Summable (fun n : ℕ => r ^ (n + 1) *
      (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, (1 - t) *
        Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * ((n : ℝ) + 1) * t) *
        Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * x * t))) ∧
    (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, (1 - t) *
      (2 * r * Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * t) /
        (1 - 2 * r * Real.cos (2 * Real.pi * t) + r ^ 2)) *
      Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * x * t)) =
      2 * (∑' n : ℕ, r ^ (n + 1) *
        (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, (1 - t) *
          Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * ((n : ℝ) + 1) * t) *
          Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * x * t)))

statement:
theorem prawitz_cdf_error_of_spectral_bound (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (U : ℝ) (hU : 0 < U) (x q R : ℝ)
    (hspectral :
      |1 + (∫ y, prawitzSignApprox (U * (x - y)) ∂μ) - 2 * q| +
        (∫ y, Real.sinc (U * (x - y) / 2) ^ 2 ∂μ) ≤ 2 * R) :

name: Causalean.Stat.CLT.BerryEsseen.prawitz_cdf_spatial_bounds
statement:
theorem prawitz_cdf_spatial_bounds (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (U : ℝ) (hU : 0 < U) (x : ℝ) :
    (1 + (∫ y, prawitzSignApprox (U * (x - y)) ∂μ) -
      (∫ y, Real.sinc (U * (x - y) / 2) ^ 2 ∂μ)) / 2 ≤ (μ (Set.Iic x)).toReal ∧
    (μ (Set.Iic x)).toReal ≤
      (1 + (∫ y, prawitzSignApprox (U * (x - y)) ∂μ) +
        (∫ y, Real.sinc (U * (x - y) / 2) ^ 2 ∂μ)) / 2

name: Causalean.Stat.CLT.BerryEsseen.prawitz_halfLine_indicator_bounds
statement:
theorem prawitz_halfLine_indicator_bounds (U : ℝ) (hU : 0 < U) (x y : ℝ) :

      (Set.Iic x).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) y ∧
    (Set.Iic x).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) y ≤
      (1 + prawitzSignApprox (U * (x - y)) + Real.sinc (U * (x - y) / 2) ^ 2) / 2

name: Causalean.Stat.CLT.BerryEsseen.prawitz_four_terms_integrable
statement:
theorem prawitz_four_terms_integrable
    (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (hfirst : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => y) μ)
    (U0 U : ℝ) (hU0 : 0 < U0) (hcut : U0 ≤ U) :
    IntervalIntegrable (fun t : ℝ =>
      ‖prawitzKernel (t / U)‖ *
        ‖charFun μ t - charFun (gaussianReal 0 1) t‖) volume 0 U0 ∧
    IntervalIntegrable (fun t : ℝ =>
      ‖prawitzKernel (t / U)‖ * ‖charFun μ t‖) volume U0 U ∧
    IntervalIntegrable (fun t : ℝ =>
      ‖prawitzKernel (t / U) / (U : ℂ) -
        Complex.I / ((2 * Real.pi * t : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ *
        Real.exp (-(t ^ 2 / 2))) volume 0 U0 ∧
    IntegrableOn (fun t : ℝ => Real.exp (-(t ^ 2 / 2)) / t)
      (Set.Ioi U0)

name: Causalean.Stat.CLT.BerryEsseen.prawitz_gaussian_sine_spectral_bound
statement:
theorem prawitz_gaussian_sine_spectral_bound
    (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (hfirst : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => y) μ)
    (U0 U : ℝ) (hU0 : 0 < U0) (hcut : U0 ≤ U) (x : ℝ) :
    |(∫ y, prawitzSignApprox (U * (x - y)) ∂μ) / 2 -
      (1 / Real.pi) * (∫ t in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ),
        Real.exp (-(t ^ 2 / 2)) * Real.sin (t * x) / t)| +
      (∫ y, Real.sinc (U * (x - y) / 2) ^ 2 ∂μ) / 2 ≤
      (2 / U) * (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..U0,
        ‖prawitzKernel (t / U)‖ *
          ‖charFun μ t - charFun (gaussianReal 0 1) t‖) +
      (2 / U) * (∫ t in U0..U,
        ‖prawitzKernel (t / U)‖ * ‖charFun μ t‖) +
      2 * (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..U0,
        ‖prawitzKernel (t / U) / (U : ℂ) -
          Complex.I / ((2 * Real.pi * t : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ *
          Real.exp (-(t ^ 2 / 2))) +
      (1 / Real.pi) * (∫ t in Set.Ioi U0,
        Real.exp (-(t ^ 2 / 2)) / t)

name: Causalean.Stat.CLT.BerryEsseen.normal_cdf_prawitz_smoothing
statement:
theorem normal_cdf_prawitz_smoothing
    (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (hfirst : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => y) μ)
    (U0 U : ℝ) (hU0 : 0 < U0) (hcut : U0 ≤ U) (x : ℝ) :
    |(μ (Set.Iic x)).toReal -
      ((gaussianReal 0 1) (Set.Iic x)).toReal| ≤
      (2 / U) * (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..U0,
        ‖prawitzKernel (t / U)‖ *
          ‖charFun μ t - charFun (gaussianReal 0 1) t‖) +
      (2 / U) * (∫ t in U0..U,
        ‖prawitzKernel (t / U)‖ * ‖charFun μ t‖) +
      2 * (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..U0,
        ‖prawitzKernel (t / U) / (U : ℂ) -
          Complex.I / ((2 * Real.pi * t : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ *
          Real.exp (-(t ^ 2 / 2))) +
      (1 / Real.pi) * (∫ t in Set.Ioi U0,
        Real.exp (-(t ^ 2 / 2)) / t)

    (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (M3 : ℝ)
    (hmean_int : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => x) μ)
    (hmean : ∫ x : ℝ, x ∂μ = 0)
    (hvar_int : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 2) μ)
    (hvar : ∫ x : ℝ, x ^ 2 ∂μ = 1)
    (hthird_int : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => |x| ^ 3) μ)
    (hthird : ∫ x : ℝ, |x| ^ 3 ∂μ ≤ M3)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) (x : ℝ) :
    |((Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => μ))
        {v : Fin n → ℝ |
          (∑ i : Fin n, v i) / Real.sqrt (n : ℝ) ≤ x}).toReal -
      ((gaussianReal 0 1) (Set.Iic x)).toReal| ≤
      M3 / Real.sqrt (n : ℝ)

    (X : ι → Ω → ℝ) (N : ι → Finset ι)
    (hmeas : ∀ i, Measurable (X i))
    {B : ℝ} (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hbound : ∀ i ω, |X i ω| ≤ B)
    (hmean : ∀ i, ∫ ω, X i ω ∂μ = 0)
    (hindep : ∀ i, IndepFun (X i) (fun ω => ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ \ N i, X j ω) μ)
    (hvar : ∫ ω, (depSum X ω) ^ 2 ∂μ = 1)
    (h : ℝ → ℝ) {C L : ℝ}
    (hb : ∀ x, |h x| ≤ C) (hd : ∀ x, |deriv h x| ≤ L) (hdiff : Differentiable ℝ h) :
    |(∫ ω, h (depSum X ω) ∂μ) - gExpect h|
      ≤ 2 * L * Real.sqrt (variance (fun ω => ∑ i, X i ω * nbhdSum X N i ω) μ)
        + L * ∑ i, ∫ ω, |X i ω| * (nbhdSum X N i ω) ^ 2 ∂μ

    (hvar : ∀ n, ∫ ω, (depSum (X n) ω) ^ 2 ∂(μ n) = 1)
    (herr1 : Tendsto
      (fun n => variance (fun ω => ∑ i, X n i ω * nbhdSum (X n) (N n) i ω) (μ n)) atTop (𝓝 0))
    (herr2 : Tendsto
      (fun n => ∑ i, ∫ ω, |X n i ω| * (nbhdSum (X n) (N n) i ω) ^ 2 ∂(μ n)) atTop (𝓝 0))
    (s : ℝ) :

    (hindep : ∀ n i, IndepFun (X n i) (fun ω => ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ \ N n i, X n j ω) (μ n))

name: Causalean.Experimentation.SuperPopulation.Network.MeanAsymptotics.networkMean_clt
statement:
theorem networkMean_clt
    {V : ℕ → Type*} [∀ n, Fintype (V n)]
    {Ω : ℕ → Type*} [∀ n, MeasurableSpace (Ω n)] (μ : ∀ n, Measure (Ω n))
    [∀ n, IsProbabilityMeasure (μ n)]
    (Y : ∀ n, V n → Ω n → ℝ)
    (adj : ∀ n, V n → V n → Prop) [∀ n, DecidableRel (adj n)]
    (hrefl : ∀ n i, adj n i i) (hsymm : ∀ n i j, adj n i j → adj n j i)
    (hmeasY : ∀ n i, Measurable (Y n i))
    (hindepY : ∀ n, ∀ A B : Finset (V n), (∀ a ∈ A, ∀ b ∈ B, ¬ adj n a b) →
      IndepFun (fun ω => fun k : A => Y n k ω) (fun ω => fun k : B => Y n k ω) (μ n))
    (m : ℕ) (hdeg : ∀ n i, (Finset.univ.filter (fun j => adj n i j)).card ≤ m)
    (hL2 : ∀ n i, MemLp (Y n i) 2 (μ n))
    (s : ℕ → ℝ) (hs_pos : ∀ n, 0 < s n)
    (hs2 : ∀ n, (s n) ^ 2 = variance (fun ω => ∑ i, Y n i ω) (μ n))
    (c : ℕ → ℝ) (hc : ∀ n i ω, |Y n i ω - ∫ x, Y n i x ∂(μ n)| ≤ c n)
    (hsmall : Tendsto (fun n => (Fintype.card (V n) : ℝ) * (c n / s n) ^ 3) atTop (𝓝 0))
    (t : ℝ) :
    Tendsto
      (fun n => (μ n).real
        {ω | (∑ i, Y n i ω - ∑ i, ∫ x, Y n i x ∂(μ n)) / s n ≤ t})
      atTop (𝓝 ((gaussianReal 0 1).real (Set.Iic t)))

statement:
theorem take_suffix_at_last_S
    {X Z S : Finset V} {p : List V} {x w : V}
    (hxX : x ∈ X) (hlen : p.length ≥ 2)
    (hact : G.IsActiveWalk (Z ∪ S) p)
    (hhead : p.head? = some x) (hlast : p.getLast? = some w) :
    ∃ (x' : V) (q : List V), x' ∈ X ∪ S ∧ q.length ≥ 2 ∧
      G.IsActiveWalk (Z ∪ S) q ∧ q.head? = some x' ∧ q.getLast? = some w ∧
      (∀ (k : ℕ) (_hk1 : 0 < k) (hk2 : k + 1 < q.length),
          q.get ⟨k, by omega⟩ ∉ S)

    (hhead : p.head? = some x) (hlast : p.getLast? = some w) :
    ∃ (x' : V) (p' : List V), x' ∈ X ∪ S ∧ p'.length ≥ 2 ∧
      G.IsActiveWalk Z p' ∧ p'.head? = some x' ∧ p'.getLast? = some w
